purpose: Request authoritative Master disposition for two teacher-target identity mismatches; editorial alternatives only, no source rewrite

records.current_example: The washer failed to spin at the end of the cycle.
records.semantic_issue: The example uses a natural verb construction but does not instantiate the nominal spin failure; a descriptive technical term should not be treated as a common household expression without context.

records.current_example: I'll warm up dinner for you when you get home late.
records.semantic_issue: Warm up dinner is idiomatic; warm up a late dinner awkwardly makes lateness an inherent attribute of a reheated meal, and revised example no longer uses original target.
